title: Study Adolescent Depression (SAD)
descriptions: Data on research project on adolescent depression.Depression during adolescence is a serious mental health problem. Difficulties in regulating evoked emotions after stressful life events are considered to lead to depression. The research project examined if depressive symptoms were mediated by various cognitive emotion regulation strategies after stressful life events, more specifically, the loss of a loved one, health threats or relational challenges.

The research article is written in English, the codebook is written in Dutch.The depositor provided the files '22a_SEM_Cond_LE_M6_basisgegevens' and '22a_SEM_Cond_LE_M6_schalen' in SAV format. DANS added the POR and DTA formats of these files for preservation and accessibility purposes.
